name: Goblin warband
description: Red and black Goblins with haste that swarm the board with tokens, throw themselves away for damage and follow a Goblin lord into battle.

cards.name: Gorvak Gutspark
cards.rule_text:
Haste
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. It gains haste until end of turn.
Whenever another Goblin you control dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.
cards.flavor_text: He never counts his warband. There are always more.

cards.name: Mother Hagga of the Spore Warren
cards.rule_text:
Sacrifice another Goblin: Add {B}, {R}, or {G}.
At the beginning of your end step, if a Goblin you controlled died this turn, create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.

cards.name: Rabble-Rousing Warcaller
cards.rule_text:
Other Goblins you control get +1/+1.
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
cards.flavor_text: Nobody listens to the plan. Everybody listens to the shouting.

cards.name: Sparkfuse Runt
cards.rule_text:
Haste
When CARDNAME dies, it deals 1 damage to any target.

cards.name: Gutter-Knife Sneak
cards.rule_text:
Menace
When CARDNAME dies, each opponent loses 1 life.

cards.name: Tunnel-Horn Blower
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters or dies, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
cards.flavor_text: One blast on the horn, and the tunnels empty.

cards.name: Pitfire Sapper
cards.rule_text:
Haste
{1}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: It deals 2 damage to target creature.

cards.name: Ashpit Bombardier
cards.rule_text:
Haste
{R}, Sacrifice another Goblin: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target. Scry 1.

cards.name: Grimewick Fortune-Teller
cards.rule_text:
Whenever another Goblin you control dies, scry 1.
{2}{B}, Sacrifice a Goblin: Draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: She reads the future in the smoke, and it always says the same thing: more.

cards.name: Kettledrum Brute
cards.rule_text:
Trample, haste
When CARDNAME enters, other Goblins you control get +1/+0 and gain haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Sewer-Grate Extortionist
cards.rule_text:
Menace
When CARDNAME enters, each opponent discards a card.

cards.name: Wartrumpet of the Hundred Tunnels
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token for each opponent you have. Goblins you control gain haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Skullpile Overlord
cards.rule_text:
Trample, haste
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, sacrifice any number of other Goblins. CARDNAME gets +2/+0 until end of turn for each Goblin sacrificed this way.
cards.flavor_text: He sits on a throne of everyone who followed him.

cards.name: Horns Under the Mountain
cards.rule_text: Create three 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens. They gain haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Toss the Runt
cards.rule_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
CARDNAME deals 3 damage to any target. If a Goblin was sacrificed this way, it deals 4 damage instead.

cards.name: Swarm of Small Blades
cards.rule_text: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Goblins you control.

cards.name: Last Howl of the Warband
cards.rule_text:
Goblins you control get +2/+0 and gain menace and haste until end of turn.
Until end of turn, whenever a Goblin you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life.

cards.name: Warren Funeral Pyre
cards.rule_text:
Whenever a Goblin you control dies, put an ember counter on CARDNAME.
Remove three ember counters from CARDNAME: It deals 3 damage to any target.

cards.name: Scrap-Heap Catapult
cards.rule_text:
Goblins you control have haste.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice a Goblin: CARDNAME deals 2 damage to any target.

cards.name: Smoke-Choked Warrens
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{3}{R}, {T}: Create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.flavor_text: Follow the smoke and you'll find them. Follow it further and they'll find you.
